title: 第23章 杀人摸尸填骨骸油水再少也赚来第24章 人虎现铁彪亡
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
黄延这边正朝着集市的方向疾奔而行。
想着早些完成大哥布置的任务，好回去汇合。
丝毫未注意到周围有什么异动。
“轰隆！”
突然间，伴随着身似雷霆一般的炸响传来。
黄延顿觉不妙，心中警铃大震。
可当他回头看去时，却发现身后一小弟，已然变成一摊碎肉横飞。
甚至几滴血水，还溅在了他的脸上。
突如其来的变故，令一行几人都是一怔。
可当反应过来后，以黄延为首一行人，皆是面露凶光。
拔出腰间长刀，恶狠狠的看向血雾中心处。
血雾间人影显露真容，正是刚刚市集小贩之一。
霎时间，黄岩目眦欲裂。
“啊，臭小子你敢！”
说罢，
黄延手中真气不断汇聚，如惊涛骇浪一般朝着林尘打来。
这一招势如雷霆，直取林尘面门。
一出手便是杀招！
空气中浓郁的血腥气，在黄延真气催使下，竟然化作丈长的掌印，直奔林尘而来。
对面林尘，手掐印诀，身前黑鼎虚影显现。

显然是打算用玄火鼎硬顶这一击！
然而，就在黄延要掌杀林尘瞬息间，他突然浑身汗毛倒竖。
常年的生死拼杀，让他相信自己的本能。
于是，黄延立刻放弃眼前林尘，
回身朝着身后拍去。
血气掌印，与冰雾形成的剑气撞在一处，瞬间炸开绚丽的冰花。
四周寒气翻腾！
顷刻间，寒气便蔓延出数十丈开外。
冰雾当中，数道白影窜出，犹如鬼魅。
方玉凝手中长剑去势不减，直刺黄延。
黄延见状大惊，立刻抬掌相对。
周身一团土黄色的气息忽隐忽现。
所谓玄骨境武者，本身已经超出凡人理解。
浑身血肉骨骼炼成一处，周身刀枪不入。
身外更有玄罡护体。
此刻，黄延身上忽隐忽现的土黄色，正是他真气化作玄罡的表现。
content_en:
Huang Yan was rushing towards the market.
I want to complete the tasks assigned by my elder brother early so that I can go back and meet up.
Didn't notice any strange movement around him.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, there was an explosion like thunder.
Huang Yan suddenly felt that something was not good, and the alarm bell rang in his heart.
But when he looked back, he found that the younger brother behind him had turned into a pile of minced meat flying everywhere.
Even a few drops of blood splashed on his face.
The sudden change made everyone in the group startled.
But when they came to their senses, Huang Yan and the others all had fierce expressions on their faces.
He pulled out the long knife from his waist and looked fiercely at the center of the blood mist.
The figure in the blood mist revealed his true appearance. He was one of the vendors in the market just now.
In an instant, Huang Yan's eyes were about to burst.
"Ah, how dare you, brat!"
After all,
The zhenqi in Huang Yan's hand continued to gather and hit Lin Chen like a stormy wave.
This move was like thunder, striking directly at Lin Chen's face.
The first move is a killer move!
The rich smell of blood in the air, driven by Huang Yan's true energy, turned into Zhang Zhang's palm prints, heading straight towards Lin Chen.
Opposite Lin Chen, making seals with his hands, a black cauldron appeared in front of him.
Obviously he planned to use the Xuanhuo Cauldron to withstand this attack!
However, just when Huang Yan was about to kill Lin Chen, the hair on his body suddenly stood up.
Years of fighting for life and death made him trust his instincts.
Therefore, Huang Yan immediately gave up on Lin Chen in front of him,
Turn around and shoot behind you.
The blood energy palm print collided with the sword energy formed by the ice mist, instantly exploding into brilliant ice flowers.
It's cold all around!
In an instant, the cold air spread dozens of feet away.
Several white shadows emerged from the ice mist, like ghosts.
The long sword in Fang Yuning's hand continued to stab Huang Yan.
Huang Yan was shocked when he saw this and immediately raised his palms to face each other.
A ball of khaki aura flickered around him.
The so-called mysterious bone realm warrior itself is beyond the understanding of ordinary people.
The flesh, blood and bones all over the body are forged into one place, making the whole body invulnerable.
There is also Xuan Gang protecting the body outside the body.
At this moment, the khaki color that flickers in and out of Huang Yan's body is the manifestation of his true energy turning into Xuangang.
